title: CORRECT: India’s Quick-Commerce Architect Eyes Long Bets
description:
The man who transformed how urban India eats, dines, and shops, Deepinder Goyal built his food delivery startup Zomato into one of the country’s biggest consumer technology companies, Eternal. At the height of its success, Goyal stepped away from the day-to-day running of the company he built, to turn his attention to a very different set of challenges with a much longer horizon. 

In an exclusive interview on his sprawling residence in Delhi, Bloomberg’s Haslinda Amin speaks with Goyal about the never-ending journeys of founders, his current pursuits, and his quest for a different kind of eternity. 

Correct: Video updated to correct currency in stock price charts at 04:12 and 07:50 of the program. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Alabama Says TikTok to Pay Up to $300 Million Over Child Safety
description: Alabama’s attorney general said TikTok has agreed to pay up to $300 million and adopt new user protection measures to settle the state’s child-safety lawsuit that was set for a jury trial to begin Monday.

title: Markets Rise as AI, Oil & Treasury Yields Drive the Week
description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Morgan Stanley Private Wealth Management Executive Director Katerina Simonetti, BMO Chief FX Strategist Mark McCormick, Jefferies Managing Director & Equity Research Analyst David Katz, Yale University Jackson Institute for Global Affairs Senior Fellow Stephen Roach, Citi Wealth Head of Portfolio Construction & Analytics Olaolu Aganga, Council on Foreign Relations Senior Fellow Rebecca Patterson, Georgetown Institute of International Economic Law Visiting Scholar Peter Harrell, & Keeneland President & CEO Shannon Arvin. (Source: Bloomberg)
